name: Legends of Meridian
summary:
Legends of Meridian is a casual, single player VR adventure.
Calloused hands pull your soggy body from the wreckage as the visage of your grandfather appears. You remember the salty sea captain who cursed his name just before your ship was wrecked. The search for your grandfather has led you to the legendary land of Loshae, and only with the mythical Oracle Jewels and the help of the inhabitants will you find a way to escape ... it won't be easy.
